about: The ANPR events the Challan Guard demo starts from: five story sightings (cases #1-#5, in this order), then seven real captures copied verbatim from the camera source (PLATE_CAPTURES joined to CAMERAS; capture_id names the row) of vehicles the RTO has registered. Each one is a *candidate* challan: a plate as a camera read it, where and when, and what the camera thought the vehicle looked like. Nothing here is a verdict - mediator/challan_guard.py decides that live, over the federation, when an operator presses Verify. Seeded with scripts/seed_challan_cases.py.

candidates.story: OCR read 8 as B. The plate as read is registered to nobody; the corrected plate is a real vehicle whose policy expired on 10/06/2026, so this fine is owed - by the right person.
OCR read 0 as O on a fully insured vehicle. Without the guard this is a wrongful challan; with it, the fine is never raised.
Same plate in Gurgaon at 11:00 and on the Agra expressway at 11:30 - about 170 km apart. No vehicle does that, so the plate exists twice: hold the fine and flag a clone.
Reported stolen on an open police case before this sighting. Fining the registered owner for their stolen car is exactly the failure the guard exists to stop - this goes to the police instead.

Registered, active, correctly read, and with no policy on record at all: a genuine uninsured-vehicle challan. Used for the dispute demo - a teammate adds a policy at the insurer, the citizen disputes, and the live re-check cancels the fine.
Real capture from the camera network: registered, correctly read, and its policy lapsed on 28/04/2026, more than three months before this sighting - a genuine uninsured-vehicle challan.

Real capture: the policy ran until 15/08/2026, so the vehicle was insured on the day it was photographed even though it has lapsed since - checking today's insurance instead of the sighting date would have fined it wrongly.
Real capture of a registered, active vehicle with no policy on record at the insurer at all - the fine is owed.
Real capture of a vehicle reported stolen on an open police case five weeks before this sighting - the police get the sighting, the owner gets no fine.
Real capture: policy expired on 16/06/2026, five weeks before this sighting at Ring Road - the fine is owed.
Real capture of a vehicle whose registration is SUSPENDED at the RTO - a registration offence, not an insurance one, so no insurance challan is raised.
Real capture: policy expired on 04/05/2026 and the vehicle was still on the road on 31/08/2026 - the fine is owed.
